✅ Addressed in commit 91b582c

** Major** · **Stability & Availability** · **Heavy lift** **Streamed output before `model_length` ends the run as a failure, with no compaction retry.** The stream throws the `context_overflow` error after text has already been yielded. The engine sends `RUN_ERROR` to `onModelError` only before output (`chat/index.ts:1986`). `withCompaction` therefore never retries this call. The run ends with a failed `RUN_ERROR` and keeps the partial text. The PR description says this case should finish with `length`, so the stream behavior does not match the stated intent. Choose one contract for streamed partial output. Either finish with `length` when text has already streamed, and throw the overflow error only when nothing has streamed. Or keep the throw and state that the run fails after partial output. Add a regression test for each case.
